methods.name: GetStatisticsAsync
invocations:
dbContext.Book
                .GroupBy(x => 1)
                .Select(x => new BookStatistics
                {
                    LowStock = x.Count(y => y.Quantity > 0 && y.Quantity < Book.LowBookThreshold),
                    OutOfStock = x.Count(y => y.Quantity == 0),
                    StockTotal = x.Count()
                }).SingleOrDefaultAsync

methods.name: GetStatisticsAsync
invocations:
dbContext.Offer
                .GroupBy(x => 1)
                .Select(x => new OfferStatistics
                {
                    PendingOffers = x.Count(y => y.OfferStatus == OfferStatus.PendingApproval),
                    OffersThisMonth = x.Count(y => y.CreatedOn >= startOfMonth),
                    OffersTotal = x.Count()
                }).SingleOrDefaultAsync

methods.name: ListAsync
invocations:
dbContext.Offer
                .Include(x => x.BookType)
                .Include(x => x.Genre)
                .Include(x => x.Condition)
                .Include(x => x.Publisher)
                .Where(x => x.Customer.Sub == sub)
                .ToListAsync

methods.name: GetStatisticsAsync
invocations:
dbContext.Order
                .GroupBy(x => 1)
                .Select(x => new OrderStatistics
                {
                    PendingOrders = x.Count(y => y.OrderStatus == OrderStatus.Pending),
                    PastDueOrders = x.Count(y => y.OrderStatus == OrderStatus.Ordered && y.DeliveryDate < DateTime.UtcNow),
                    OrdersThisMonth = x.Count(y => y.CreatedOn >= startOfMonth),
                    OrdersTotal = x.Count()
                }).SingleOrDefaultAsync
